list: The 55-trophy list as published for PlayStation 5 (Exophase list reported by Push Square, 18 Nov 2026): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden; no online trophies. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as listed. GTA VI launches 19 Nov 2026, so every guide below is built from the official description alone and says so where the description gives no method.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the Platinum: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Treat it as the finish line of the roadmap below, not as a trophy to chase directly — the last trophy you earn before it will almost certainly be A Long Road (100% completion) or one of the big grind trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so this trophy comes naturally at the start of the game and cannot be missed — just follow the mission objectives until the mission-complete screen appears.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock by playing the story through in order, so keep following the main mission markers; there is no side requirement hidden in the description. Do the Chapter 1 meditation spot for Positive Mental Attitude before this chapter ends, because that spot is reported to disappear afterwards.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies, this one is earned by playing the main story in order; the description asks for nothing extra. Guides note that most of the list opens up once both protagonists are playable from Chapter 2, so use this chapter to start the side activities and collectibles that feed the later trophies.

The robbery trophies are reported to unlock in Chapters 3 and 4, so keep an eye out for heist-style missions and side content as this chapter runs.

Because guides report there is no mission replay, make a manual save before the final mission so you can return to the open world afterwards for clean-up.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's own completion tracker. This is the second gold trophy and the hardest one in the list: it is not about finishing the story, it is about the in-game checklist behind the completion percentage (story, stranger missions, activities and collectibles as the game counts them). Work through this guide's roadmap in order and check the in-game completion screen regularly so you can see which category is still short. Guides stress that 100% completion does not necessarily mean doing literally everything in the game — only what the tracker counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, flips, near-misses and the other stunt moves the game counts. This is a grind trophy, so fold it into normal play: take jumps and ramps whenever you are driving between missions instead of treating it as a separate chore. The counter is cumulative, so every stunt you pull from the start of the game counts toward the 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type the game offers at least once — one go at each, not mastery of any. The description does not name the activity types or how many there are, so use the in-game activities menu as your checklist and tick each type off as you try it; the trophy pops when the last untried type is done. A good early-game trophy: try a new activity whenever you pass one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. PlayStation tracks 42 Shooting Range challenges for this trophy, so this is a long accuracy grind rather than a single visit: work through the range's challenge list, golding each one, and return with better weapons or upgrades if a challenge resists you. The description asks for gold in all of them, so a silver on even one challenge holds the trophy back.

trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its locations — every location, not just one win. The description does not list how many locations there are, so follow the in-game race list and clear each location in turn; a win at a location you have already won does not advance the trophy. Learn each course's corners before pushing for the win.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The word different matters: winning the same race 20 times does not count, so work through the race list and win 20 distinct events. Mix race types as you go — it also feeds Master of None and keeps the grind varied.

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head, so this is about out-fishing one rival rather than catching a set number of fish: enter a fishing challenge against Cal and finish ahead of him. If you lose, enter again — the trophy only needs one win.

trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as icons in the world; each strand is a small chain of missions for one stranger, and the trophy needs 8 strands finished end to end, not 8 single missions. Explore the map between story missions, take every stranger icon you find, and keep returning to the same strangers until their chains close.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. This is the list's one missable trophy: guides report that Lucia's balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 counts toward it and disappears after that chapter, and that the game has no mission replay — so meditate at the Chapter 1 spot before you finish Chapter 1, and make a manual save at the start of every chapter. KeenGamer lists 18 required spots in total; use the in-game map to find each one and meditate at it.

trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. This is a hunting job for a named character, not general hunting: take Bret's request, track the one unique animal it names, and bring it down. trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; a set is complete only when every card in it is found, and the trophy needs 3 sets finished. Pick up every card you pass while doing other things, and use the in-game collection screen to see which sets are one or two cards short before you go hunting for the stragglers.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. This is a long location grind: the count is 100, and the description says locations, so spreading the action across the map matters more than repeating it in one place. Do a few WAiNK Its in every new area you visit so the total climbs while you explore for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's small optional objectives, and the count is cumulative across all types — so the fastest route is breadth: clear the easy challenges in every category rather than grinding one hard type 50 times. Check the challenges menu to see which ones are nearly done.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. Both parts matter: your partner must be with you when the wanted level hits 4 stars, and you must then break line of sight and get clear until the stars drop. Use a fast car, put distance between yourself and the police, and stay out of their view until the heat is gone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the wanted level must stay on through all three robberies. Plan a route past three shops close together, keep your partner with you, and move fast between them; if the wanted level drops to zero before the third robbery, the chain breaks and you start again.

The game logs a vehicle the first time you encounter it, so variety is the whole job: drive, ride and fly everything you find instead of sticking to one favourite car. New areas and vehicle types add new discoveries, so this climbs naturally while you explore Leonida for The Goodtime State.

Set it up before you trigger the ability: find a spot with at least 5 enemies close together, then activate Combat Focus and drop all 5 before it ends. If you only get 4, the attempt does not count — reposition and try again in a busier fight.

The description is deliberately vague about the exact method, and guides list no confirmed step for it at launch, so treat it as an open-world stunt at the airport: get a plane airborne from VCIA outside any mission or scheduled departure and see it through. trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point — no alarm, no spotted prompt, no wanted level from the robbery itself. Plan the approach before you act: go in quietly, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails, so leave and try again rather than fighting your way out.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault counts only if you get away clean afterwards, so a robbery that ends in a bust or a death does not add to the 5. The robbery trophies are reported to unlock in Chapters 3 and 4, so expect bank vaults to open up in the later story — work through them one at a time and escape before moving to the next.

trophies.guide: Rob one armored truck and escape afterwards. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida, so watch for one on the move, stop it, take the cash, and then break away clean — the escape is part of the trophy, so have a fast getaway vehicle ready before you strike.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida until the whole map is uncovered. The description sets no number of areas, so use the in-game map as the checklist: any grey or unvisited region is still to do. Drive the coastline, the swamps and the city districts between missions, and pair this with Whip It Good and You WAiNKer!, which both reward the same exploring.

trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in the game. The description does not name the gangs or say how many there are, so work from the in-game world: find each gang's illegal operation, rob it, and move on to the next gang's. A gang whose operation you have already robbed does not count twice.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, and your contacts turn them into clean cash — the trophy counts the laundered total, so keep feeding bills through your contacts across the whole playthrough rather than letting them pile up. Robbery trophies such as Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play are a natural source of the bills.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. The total is cumulative and counts every shop in the game, so just buy what you need as you play — clothes, weapons, food and gear all add up. If you reach the endgame short of the total, the quickest top-up is buying expensive items you still want, since the trophy counts spending, not what you buy.

Garages also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you register for On the Spot, so buy them as you go.
